how_to_apply: Fill in the "Application Format for Walk-In Interview" given at the end of the notice. Leave no column blank, and write the details in words, not indices or dots.
Write the name of the post applied for clearly, with reference to the advertisement. Use a separate application form for each post, each with its own fee.
Enter the bank draft number, date, amount and bank name, or the online payment reference or transaction number, in the form.
Paste your photograph, sign the declaration, and enclose the self-attested copies the form asks for.
Give an undertaking that you are not occupied with any other assignment elsewhere.
Bring the filled-in application with the fee to the walk-in interview on 13 November 2026 at 11:30 AM.
important_instructions: Unsigned or incomplete applications will be summarily rejected. So will applications without the fee or supporting documents, and applications received late. The number of vacancies may be increased or decreased. The University reserves the right to fill or not to fill the post. Candidates must have at least one working email, which will be used during the entire selection process. Any modification or corrigendum will be uploaded only on the University website, www.gbu.ac.in. No other means of communication will be used. No TA/DA will be paid for appearing in the interview. Interim correspondence or enquiries will not be entertained or replied to. Any attempt to influence the recruitment process will lead to disqualification. In any dispute, the decision of the Competent Authority, GBU, is final. Unauthorized absence for a continuous period of 06 days without valid reasons and without prior intimation may lead to termination. The Dean of the School ensures regular attendance. To resign, at least one month's prior notice is required. Otherwise the Competent Authority may forfeit the emolument. Service may be terminated for misconduct, poor performance, concealing facts or canvassing. A candidate who leaves without permission will not get a Certificate of Experience or the dues for that day. The working candidate must submit a No Dues Certificate to the Dean of the School. Selected candidates have no right to claim regularization, absorption or a further contract.

content_sections.heading: About GBU
content_sections.text: Gautam Buddha University is a university in Greater Noida, Gautam Budh Nagar, Uttar Pradesh. This walk-in is for its Department of Education of Training under the School of Humanities and Social Sciences. The posts are for Academic Session 2026-27.

content_sections.heading: Posts and Eligibility
content_sections.text: The notice offers 02 posts of Assistant Professor (On Contract for Fixed Duration) in the Department of Education of Training, School of Humanities and Social Sciences. The required specialization and qualification printed in the vacancy table is Core Botany. Candidates must hold their qualifications at the time of submitting the application. These qualifications must meet the norms prescribed by the concerned regulatory bodies, such as CoA/AICTE/UGC. The notice also says that applicants should be from a reputed Institute/University. They may have evidence of published research work and teaching experience at the University/IIT/NIT level. The University follows the reservation norms of the U.P. Government for SC, ST, OBC and PwDs. Only the approved list of SC, ST and OBC categories is applicable at Gautam Buddha University. The conditions for reserved categories are: SC/ST and OBC-NCL candidates must produce a copy of the caste certificate in the format prescribed by the Government, as and when required. OBC candidates under the creamy layer will not get the advantage of reservation under the OBC category. Candidates who claim to be from the Economically Weaker Section (EWS) must fulfil the criteria under U.P. Government rules. The notice does not give a category-wise break-up of the 02 posts. Candidates should check the official notification for the discipline-specific eligibility of the post.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Terms of Engagement
content_sections.text: The monthly emolument (honorarium) for Assistant Professor (OCFD) is Rs. 57,700/- (Rs. Fifty Seven Thousand Seven Hundred only) per month for those having NET or Ph.D., as per UGC/CoA guidelines and other regulatory bodies like AICTE, at the entry level of Assistant Professor. The notice adds in brackets: "Candidates having M.Tech or equivalent in I.C.T./Engineering/PG Qualification in the relevant discipline/subject in accordance with the UGC regulations/rules of Concerned Regulatory Bodies". The honorarium finalized by the Selection Committee at the interview is final and stands for the entire duration of the engagement. A change in qualification after the interview will not change the honorarium. Selection does not give a right to the allowances and benefits admissible to regular faculty. The terms of engagement printed in the notice are: The engagement is for Academic Session 2026-27 only, for a maximum of 11 months or as per the requirement indicated. The Assistant Professor (OCFD) will be a full-time worker for the entire contract period and must follow the administrative and disciplinary regulations of GBU. Failure to comply is a ground for termination without notice. Working hours and days are the same as for regular employees of GBU. No extra benefit is allowed for working beyond office hours. Casual leave is 05 (five) days per semester. Academic leave is 05 (five) days at most for the entire engagement in Academic Session 2026-27, for academic meets and training programmes. Selected candidates may be provided accommodation on the University campus as per availability, on the University's terms and conditions. Selected candidates may bring any type of project from a Govt./Corporate funding agency, on the conditions laid down by the University. Selected candidates will not be allowed to accept or hold any other full-time or part-time assignment, online or offline, during the engagement.

content_sections.heading: GBU Assistant Professor (OCFD) Job Description
content_sections.text: Perform all duties assigned by the University. Complete the entire examination process for all types of examination (Regular/Back paper/Special paper/Repeat, etc.) for the courses allocated, even if the term of contract is complete.

content_sections.heading: Application Fee
content_sections.text: The fee is paid by bank draft payable to the Gautam Buddha University, Greater Noida. The notice also gives details for online payment. The online payment reference number or transaction number must be filled in the application form.

content_sections.heading: What to Bring
content_sections.text: The filled-in, signed application form in the prescribed format, with your photograph The fee: a bank draft, or the online payment reference or transaction number written in the form The original photo ID proof indicated in the application, for verification Original testimonials. Applicants without them will not be allowed to appear in the interview. Category certificate (enclose an authentic certificate) Self-attested copies of certificates and mark sheets for all academic qualifications Self-attested copies for all service experience mentioned A list of publications with the first page of each published paper or its acceptance letter Separate sheets for additional qualifications, awards, research or projects supervised, and seminars or conferences, with titles of papers presented Details of two references who live in India and know your character and work, with their affiliation, mobile number and email. References must not be relatives.

content_sections.heading: What Happens on the Day
content_sections.text: Candidates must appear in person, as the walk-in interview is held in physical mode only. Original certificates and documents supporting the application are checked at the interview. No deviation from the details filled in the form is entertained. The Selection Committee finalizes the honorarium at the interview. Selected candidates must join duties physically in the Department at GBU.

faq.question: Q1. When is the GBU Assistant Professor (OCFD) walk-in interview?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview is on 13 November 2026 (Friday) at 11:30 AM onwards. It is for the Department of Education of Training, School of Humanities and Social Sciences, Gautam Buddha University, Greater Noida.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are there?
faq.answer: There are 02 posts of Assistant Professor (On Contract for Fixed Duration). The notice says the number may be increased or decreased.

faq.question: Q3. What qualification is required?
faq.answer: The required specialization is Core Botany. Candidates must hold qualifications as per the norms of the concerned regulatory bodies, such as CoA/AICTE/UGC, at the time of submitting the application.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary of GBU Assistant Professor (OCFD)?
faq.answer: The honorarium is Rs. 57,700 per month for those having NET or Ph.D. The amount finalized by the Selection Committee at the interview stays fixed for the entire engagement.

faq.question: Q5. What is the application fee?
faq.answer: The fee is Rs. 1000. SC/ST/OBC/differently-abled persons pay Rs. 500 on submission of valid documents. The fee is paid by bank draft payable to Gautam Buddha University, Greater Noida, or online to the University's Punjab National Bank account.

faq.question: Q6. What documents should I bring to the walk-in interview?
faq.answer: Bring the filled-in application in the prescribed format with the fee, the original photo ID proof, and original testimonials. Also bring self-attested copies of certificates, mark sheets, experience and publications. Applicants without original testimonials will not be allowed to appear.

faq.question: Q7. How will candidates be selected?
faq.answer: Selection is through a walk-in interview held in physical mode only. Original documents are checked at the interview, and the Selection Committee finalizes the honorarium.

faq.question: Q8. Is the GBU Assistant Professor (OCFD) post permanent?
faq.answer: No. The engagement is for Academic Session 2026-27 only, for a maximum of 11 months or as per the requirement indicated. It gives no right to permanent appointment or regularization.

faq.question: Q9. Will TA/DA be paid for attending the interview?
faq.answer: No. The notice states that no TA/DA will be paid for appearing in the interview.

faq.question: Q10. Can I apply for more than one post?
faq.answer: Yes. A separate application form, with its own fee, must be filled for each post, with the name of the post written clearly.
